items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I ran into Phil Schaap and he said he found that A Kiss" thing with "Say It With from the movie.

ctx.x: I think when we come to put the tapes that I have together with the ones that you have, there will be more than that.
So maybe we can work up some hours and get Phil Schaap to do a Maxine Sullivan festival.
